3D MODEL IMPORT TEST FIXTURES

The triangle geometry and glTF wrappers in draco.gltf, meshopt.gltf and
ktx2.gltf were created for these tests. Embedded PNG bytes come from the
existing tests/fixtures/portrait.png fixture.

normal.ktx2 is an unmodified copy of the normal/bump texture from
Anisotropy Barn Lamp.
